fact: On 17 June 2025 Bank Al-Maghrib and the Haut-Commissariat au Plan signed a partnership convention committing to set up a secure, automated data-exchange system for statistics (central bank records as the administrative source); no published statistics from it are named.
title: Bank Al-Maghrib et le Haut-Commissariat au Plan renforcent leur coopération pour un système statistique national plus intégré
